facts: Yummy! Dogs have about 1,700 taste buds. Humans have approximately 9,000 and cats have around 473.
In general, smaller breeds live longer than larger breeds.
Dogs are naturally submissive to any creature with a higher pack status.
Dogs can be trained to detect cancer in humans.
The oldest dog on record was a Australian Cattle Dog named Bluey, who lived to be 29 years and 5 months old.
